sources.entry: RStudio Server - Web browser based IDE for R. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Java/C++

summary.one_liner: RStudio is an integrated development environment for the R programming language, available as a desktop app or as a server that multiple users can access through a web browser.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes RStudio as an IDE for R with a customizable workbench that combines console, terminal, source editor, plots, environment, history, help, files, and packages panes. It has a syntax-highlighting editor with code completion and can run code directly from the editor by line, selection, or file. It supports authoring reproducible documents and reports with Quarto and R Markdown, and also supports Sweave and TeX documents. Optional AI features are listed, including GitHub Copilot completions, Posit AI Pass Next Edit Suggestions, and the Posit Assistant. It can be run as a server so multiple users access the IDE in a web browser.
use_cases: writing and running R code in an IDE
authoring reproducible reports with Quarto or R Markdown
providing a shared browser-based R environment for multiple users
analyzing data and viewing plots in R
notable: Can run as a server so several users work in the IDE through a web browser
Integrated workbench with console, source, plots, environment, history, help, files, and packages panes
Authoring support for Quarto and R Markdown reproducible documents
Optional AI features including GitHub Copilot completions and Posit Assistant
Runs on Windows, Mac, and Linux, with a community-maintained FreeBSD port
caveats: The README does not include install or run instructions; it points to INSTALL in the distribution for building from source
Some AI features are optional and their use depends on separate services named in the README
